Status Report

Date: 1 Feb 2025  
Time: 05:04 AM  

As the majority of the naval forces of Ekpatanus are actively safeguarding the trade routes and territorial waters of our nation and our allies, reports indicate that today, at 04:08 AM, a portion of the naval forces has been deployed in the waters near Raj and the colonial territories of Gendarme. 

These forces include:

- 2 ships of class: LHA (Πλοίο Αμφίβιων Επιθέσεων)
- 4 submarines of class: SSBN (Υποβρύχιο με Πυραύλους)
- 4 warships of classes:
  - CGN (Πολεμικά Πλοία με Πυρηνικά)
  - CG (Πολεμικά Πλοία με Πυραύλους)

These forces are commanded by Alexios Reiner. It is important to note that these forces will only engage in operations if our allies require support during critical situations.

Additionally, just moments ago, 5 Antonov An-178 aircraft carrying 360 Marine Corps soldiers and necessary supplies for Gendarme forces have landed in the colonial territories of Gendarme. The duty of these troops is to safeguard strategically sensitive areas in the event of ground combat.

These deployments underscore the steadfast commitment of the Kingdom of Ekpatanus to support our allies and maintain security in the region. Continuous monitoring of the situation and readiness of these forces will remain a top priority.

End of Report

[spoiler=Sibling Drama][b]Lumièreville, Montreux Island, Capital of Capricorn
Central Chain of Command Residence[/b]

[i]Étienne Leclerc laid idle at his residence, his successful departure from the war zone in Juane gave him a triumphant feeling. But he still had one thing he was still dreading about, his younger sister Isabelle, was still in Juane. She was commanding the Juanese fighting force combating the Bravanorian army and that feeling that he left his younger sister to fight alone left a bad taste in his mouth. What if she were to die in the fighting?, what older brother would leave his sister, a woman, to die in such a harsh environment?  He had to make sure she was okay, and so he did. Étienne grabbed a nearby military grade telephone, and immediately dialed the closest General Quarters to the front lines. "[b]General Quarters Sector 1.06, what is your request?[/b]" the voice on the phone didn't sound like his sister, more of an older individual who was working communications. "[b]This is Admiral Étienne Leclerc, Military Governer of Alicia and Capricorn. Verification code:1.6.3.6.2. Red Barron, I repeat,  Verification code:1.6.3.6.2. Red Barron.[/b]" the recipient took a second before verifying that it really was the Admiral. "[b]Greetings Admiral Leclerc, our utmost apology for the delay. May I ask, what is your request?[/b]" "[b]I would like to request an immediate calling channel between me and Colonel Isabelle Leclerc-Dufresne.[/b]" a couple moments passed before the Admiral would get a response from the quarters. "[b]Your request has been approved, a confidential communication channel will be created soon.[/b]" "[b]Colonel Isabelle Leclerc-Dufresne speaking, who is this?[/b]" Hearing the polite voice of his little sister made Étienne feel as if a huge weight had been lifted from his shoulder. "[b]It's me, Étienne. I haven't talked to you since the war started! Forgive me, please.[/b]" Isabelle stayed silent for a couple of moments, getting a call from her older brother who allegedly "abandoned" her was extremely contradicting. "[b]What do you want?, to spoil me with compliments on how you love and miss me before leaving me for another six months?[/b]" she shot back, Étienne felt as if the weight was  put on his shoulder again. "[b]Isabelle, you don't understand-[/b]" "[b]Oh shut up, if you want to waste my time, then hang up the damn phone. Get to the point already, what the fvck do you want from me you enculé!(bastard)[/b]" Étienne let out a large sigh before responding "[b]Isabelle, I know what I did to you was wrong. But we are in a time of war, our country is in danger. I had to make the choice of leaving the island or I could get killed. Gregoire gave me full control of the Gendarmite army in Alicia and Capricorn. My safety is of the highest priority.[/b]" Étienne heard Isabelle making an explicit swear against him before continuing. "[b]And in that option, you've left me to fight alone. You could've flied me with you, but I end up having to be the MAN in this situation.[/b]" "[b]Isabelle, you don't seem to understand. If there's anyone I can trust in control of the defense of Juane, it's you. You were born there, you know every route, every trap, and every corner that the island has. I know you can do this, I trust you. That is why I'm authorizing Jomish support to help ensure that the island is not occupied by the invader, and that you don't have to stress yourself too much to defend such an important island[/b]."  Isabelle remained silent for a couple of moments, hearing the genuine voice of her older brother which actually sounded like he care was a once in a lifetime event for her. "[b]Alright then, so what do you want? I'm really ought to sleep after hearing your whole apology video.[/b]" Étienne chuckled, "[b]You bet!, well. How is the war going?, any updates?[/b]" "[b]It's really a toss over here, our divisions have created a successful incursion in Sebatião. Resistance hasn't been much, we've even recorded a couple videos capturing and mocking Bravanorian POWs![/b]" she giggled, "[b]Good, just make sure to not do anything to does p*ssies. We don't want any war crimes on our hands. Haha![/b]" Étienne was feeling better than ever, maybe the war wouldn't be as bad as he thought? Wouldn't it. "[b]Well, I'll keep you updated on the current situation, the Daily Bird is a really biased News Station, can't ever believe what they say. They're mainly run by hippies who like to make everything about 'Elesyr bad' ya get me?![/b]" Isabelle snickered. "[b]Well then, take care. I don't wanna come there like a Knight in Shining armor to save your ass![/b]" Little did Étienne know, his joke would be factual. [/i][/spoiler]

[pre]The Gendarmite Harold | Daily Bird | Fox News [/pre] 

[b][February.1.2025][/b]

[i]The border between Gendarme and Bravanor remained silent, fear and tension filled the atmosphere of both sides. Today was the day, that the Gendarmites would begin their first action to secure victory against the Bravanorians. Admiral Étienne Leclerc had begun the ordering of a planned preemptive strike to knockout the Bravanorians before they could ever strike. The prior day was filled with battery strikes that mainly targeted Bravanorian infrastructure and military logisitics, reports of success of these strikes were still undetermined. Gendarmite Strategic defense forces reported shooting down multiple Bravanorian reconnaissance drones that were attempting to capture Intel of Gendarmite military installations and infrastrucutre.[/i]

[b]INVASION OF SOUTHERN JUANE[/b]

[i]A soldier exited his trench, today would be the day the war officially started. Colonelle Isabelle Dufresne had ordered all soldiers to rally at the commanding station to begin the operation. As the soldier exited his trench, he'd notice the rancid smell of overripe meat within one of the quarters of his comrades. This stench wouldn't be the most pleasing thing to wake up to but he had to keep going, running on only 4 hours of sleep his body felt numb. After a short ten minute commute to the General Quarters of the trench system, the soldier would open a door revealing Isabelle's living quarters. "[b]You're on time.[/b]" Isabelle would comment, she was a young, beautiful, woman. What was such an individual doing here? Ordering men to their deaths on a hot, dense, stinky island that was prone to mosquitoes in the summer time. She was the younger sister of the newly proclaimed Capricornian governor Admiral Étienne Leclerc, he gave her complete control of the Juane fighting force after he departed back to Alicia to regroup and revise his army. "[b]Forgive me madam, the conditions here are terrible, I was awoken by the buzzing of mosquitoes![/b]"  The soldier would reply, bowing down before the small woman as gesture of admiration, but she was having none of it. "[b]Maybe you should be woken up by the screaming of your comrades fighting at the front because you were too damn lazy to get the hell out of bed![/b]" she jeered his remarks. "[b]I'm so-[/b]" "[b]Get the hell out of my office!, all of you should be ready within 20 minutes! If I catch any of you maggots trying to escape the fighting, I'll personally kick your face in![/b]" The soldier immediately ran out the room in distress, he really was going to die on a tropical hell-hole.[/i]

[i][u]20 MINUTES LATER[/u]
[/i]
[i]The soldier reached his post, he was a part of the 1ère Section de Choc(1st Shock Section), a jungle specialized platoon consisting of 40 soldiers, and 2 AMX-10RC light tanks. The 1ère Section de Choc was one of 50 different platoons that were apart of the Brigade de Choc de la République(Shock Brigade of the Republic) which was instructed to commence the invasion of Bravanorian occupied Juane. He and his comrades were to take an uncharted route that would lead them straight to the Bravanorian border in under an hour. As the sixth hour of the day approached, the soldier and his army would venture out into the dense jungles of Juane to engage the enemy. 

The soldier took the current downtime to get the much needed sleep that he would require to survive the war zone. "[b]Wake the hell up![/b]" the demand of his comrade jolted the soldier awake. After rubbing his eyes for a couple moments the soldier would see a tall, stocky man infront of him. The sight of such an intimidating individual frightened him, if he was this scared of his own comrades how did he expect to survive against people who are actually trying to kill him? The soldier thought to himself, little did he know, his sudden blanking out infuriated the soldier even more as his giant hands grabbed him by the collar.  "[b]Please!, pardon me of my incompetence! I have fought in a war before, nor have I ever killed a man!. [/b]" the boy begged, "[b]Oh you won't be the one doing the killing alright. Keep acting like such a p*ssy and you'll have a 2 inch crater straight in your forehead! It'd be best for me to kill you now, and not have to worry about them capturing and milking your fragile ass for information because you know too damn much yet do too little!"[/b] the giant wrapped his hands around the soldier's neck before suddenly constricting over it, the boy felt as if he was going to die right here, by the hands of a comrade, who could pardon themselves by accusing the soldier that he had conspired to defect. As the light started fading away the soldier would see a hand pat the giant's back. Instantly, he let go of the soldier. As the soldier regurgitated air back into his lungs, he could see a short figure jeering the man who had almost killed him. The figure had what seemed to be multiple war badges on his chest, a sign that he was to be treated with the utmost respect. As the man turned his focus from the giant, he moved towards the fallen soldier and opened a hand. "[b]Welcome to the army.[/b]"[/i]
[b]_____________________[/b]

[b]Juane News Station, Villemontier, Juane Island.[/b]

[i]"[b]Are we live?[/b]" the news reporter asked, the cameraman raised his thumb approving of her question. The news reporter sighed before focusing her attention on the camera, "[b]Good morning citizens of Juane!,  this is the Daily Bird in Juane giving you the latest and most unbiased news information on the current crisis between Gendarme and the Étrangère(Foreign powers)! Currently, a border conflict has escalated to full-scale war between the Commonwealth of Gendarme and the Imperio of Bravanor. All citizens residing in southern Juane have been evacuated and we strongly recommend that any civilian still residing within Juane follow evacuation procedures to ensure that they are safe. The Gendarmite Commonwealth has amended a policy to give civilians displaced by the conflict free residence within Alicia to support its growing population and industry! Ahead of that now, a lot of information has been released on the current state of the war. Gendarmite officials claim that the Capricornian army has made several advances within Bravanorian occupied territory within Southern Gendarme. These claims have been backed with hundreds of photos and videos of Gendarmite flags being waved on nearby villages in Bravanor. [/b]" The reporting transitions to a blurred video of Gendarmite troops storming a village. "[b]While we try our best to receive the most trustworthy unbiased information, such events like these need time to marinate before accurate reporting can be held. That sums it up for today, this is the Daily Bird, your unbiased news network.[/b]" the screen would cut off therefore ending the reporting. [/i][/spoiler][/quote]

[i]Linda galera que, em noite apagada
Vai navegando num mar imenso
Nos traz saudades da terra amada
Da pátria minha em que tanto penso

[/i]]
[i]Senhor almirante senhor[/i]
O jovem fuzileiro chegou a frente do almirante, o saudou e disse.
[i]Acabamos de chegar em terra, São Sebastião está se defendendo dos Gendarmitas bravamente sobre o comando do coronel Marques, senhor.[/i]
O almirante Soares se virou, e disse.
[i]Relatório, todos navios de logística e transporte desembarcaram em segurança?[/i]
[i]Senhor sim senhor Almirante, o desembarque foi um sucesso, e os soldados estão marchando até São Sebastião onde organizaram as defesas e preparações para a ofensiva.[/i]
O almirante acena satisfeito, e dispensa o jovem fuzileiro, e então volta sua atenção a grandes cilindros no convés do navio, ele põe a mão em admiração da arma, era um Míssel MSSI, um míssel superfície-superfície, montado em diversos cruzadores imperiais, incluindo o Cisne Branco, haviam outros misseis anti navio e anti aéreos, mas o foco atual é o MSSI.
O almirante retornou a sua cabine, ajustando sua gravata e uniforme, e  fez uma transmissão com o Coronel Marques.
[i]Coronel, como está a situação em Sebastião?[/i]
[i]Tivemos diversos drones abatidos antes da informação chegar senhor almirante, ao que indica os Gendarmitas já se entrincheiraram e estão se movendo com sua infantaria e tanques[/i]
[i]Tanques coronel...?
Em uma selva tropical?
Soa...imprudente, tanques em tais locais tem pouca ou nenhuma utilidade, de qualquer maneira, obrigado pelo relatório Coronel.[/i]
A transmissão terminou, e então outra ligação ocorreu, Santa Rosa, um navio comercial, que guardava alguns agentes infiltrados em Sebastião há cerca de 2 dias, algumas fotos e informações foram tiradas de bases militares, sabotadores inclusive danificando algumas defesas anti aéreas da cidade, o Capitão do navio, Filiberto Santana então fez uma ligação, o navio era dele, mas se tornou do exército para essa missão de infiltragem, devido a guerra ele saiu e retornou a Bravanor, enquanto estava no mar, ele recebeu uma ligação do Almirante.
[i]Saudações, capitão, agradeço por sua bravura em deixar nossos agentes usarem seu navio temporariamente, como dizem, Verás que um filho teu não foge a luta[/i]
[i]Saudações senhor almirante, os dados foram todos enviados ao senhor, e fotos também, soube que alguns agentes também sabotaram as defesas aéreas da cidade[/i]
[i]Obrigado novamente capitão, essas informações serão cruciais para o bem do Império, Viva o imperador, [b]AVE IMPÉRIO[/b][/i]
A transmissão acabou
Com a permissão prévia dos outros subordinados comandantes da frota,  o almirante abriu um mapa-radar da região, as fotos e informações foram detectadas em uma região da ilha, foram localizados os quartéis e depósitos de munição locais.
[b]ALVO DEFINIDO, CIDADE DE [nome_que_eu_não_sei[/b]
O botão foi apertado, e [i] um numero[/i] de misseis foram lançados, o Almirante olhou para os misseis, saudando conforme eles saíam dos cilindros se projetando para fora e falou.
[b]AVE IMPÉRIO[/b]
---------------------------------------------------
Enquanto isso em outras áreas, vários navios desembarcavam com os reforços, haviam dezenas de milhares de soldados saindo dos navios e fazendo seus caminhos pela selva até chegarem em Sebastião.
Enquanto isso em Sebastião.
[i]Escutem aqui, os reforços chegaram, navios aliados desembarcaram em nossos portos com reforços, eles chegarão muito em breve, enquanto isso a frota imperial ficara de vigília na região, impedindo quaisquer navio de nos atacar, ou submarinos, preparem os obuses e artilharias, as defesas anti aéreas já foram armadas, quero ver todos participando, lutem pelo Império, mostrem como os bravanianos lutam.
[b]AVE IMPÉRIO[/b]

[/i]

[b]Translation[/b]
Sir Admiral Sir
The young marine came in front of the admiral, saluted him and said.
We have just arrived on land, São Sebastião is defending itself bravely from the Gendarmites under the command of Colonel Marques, sir.
Admiral Soares turned and said.
Report, have all logistics and transport ships landed safely?
Yes Sir Admiral, the landing was a success, and the soldiers are marching to São Sebastião where they have organized the defenses and preparations for the offensive.
The admiral nods in satisfaction, and dismisses the young marine, and then turns his attention to large cylinders on the deck of the ship, he puts his hand in admiration of the weapon, it was an MSSI Missile, a surface-to-surface missile, mounted on several imperial cruisers, including the White Swan, there were other anti-ship and anti-air missiles, but the current focus is the MSSI.
The Admiral returned to his cabin, adjusting his tie and uniform, and made a transmission with Colonel Marques.
Colonel, how is the situation in Sebastião?
We had several drones shot down before the information arrived, Admiral, it seems that the Gendarmites have already dug in and are moving with their infantry and tanks.
Tanks, Colonel...?
In a tropical jungle?
Sounds...unwise, tanks in such places have little or no use, anyway, thanks for the report, Colonel.
The transmission ended, and then another call occurred, Santa Rosa, a commercial ship, which had been guarding some agents infiltrated in Sebastião for about 2 days, some photos and information were taken of military bases, saboteurs even damaging some anti-aircraft defenses in the city, the Captain of the ship, Filiberto Santana then made a call, the ship was his, but it became part of the army for this infiltration mission, due to the war he left and returned to Bravanor, while he was at sea, he received a call from the Admiral. Greetings, Captain, I thank you for your bravery in letting our agents use your ship temporarily, as they say, You will see that a son of yours does not run away from a fight
Greetings, Sir Admiral, the data has all been sent to you, and photos too, I heard that some agents also sabotaged the city's air defenses
Thank you again, Captain, this information will be crucial for the good of the Empire, Long live the Emperor, AVE IMPÉRIO
The transmission ended
With the prior permission of the other subordinate commanders of the fleet, the Admiral opened a radar map of the region, the photos and information were detected in a region of the island, the local barracks and ammunition depots were located.
[b]TARGET DEFINED, CITY OF [name_that_I_don't_know_name][/b]
The button was pressed, and a number of missiles were launched, the Admiral looked at the missiles, saluting as they left the cylinders projecting outwards and spoke.
AVE IMPÉRIO
---------------------------------------------------
Meanwhile, in other areas, several ships were landing with reinforcements. There were tens of thousands of soldiers leaving the ships and making their way through the jungle until they reached Sebastião.
Meanwhile, in Sebastião.
Listen here, the reinforcements have arrived. Allied ships have landed in our ports with reinforcements. They will arrive very soon. Meanwhile, the Imperial fleet will remain on watch in the region, preventing any ships or submarines from attacking us. Prepare the howitzers and artillery. The anti-aircraft defenses have already been set up. I want to see everyone participating. Fight for the Empire. Show us how the Bravanians fight.
AVE IMPÉRIO
[/Spoiler]
